title: SSL/TLS inspection rules a tenant profile depends on

checks.do: Whether the login-service application, not the content application, appears as a criterion in an inspection rule ahead of any rule that bypasses it.

ssl-rule-required.statement: When a tenant profile is associated with a cloud application rule, the application must be selected as a criterion in an SSL/TLS Inspection rule.

quotes: Ensure to select these cloud applications as a criterion in an SSL/TLS Inspection rule if their tenant profiles are associated with a cloud application rule.

office365-rule.statement: For Office 365, the SSL/TLS Inspection rule selects Microsoft Login Services as the cloud application and must sit at a rule order higher than the Office 365 One Click Rule.

quotes: Office 365: Select Microsoft Login Services as the cloud application with a rule order higher than Office 365 One Click Rule.

google-rule.statement: For Google Apps, the SSL/TLS Inspection rule selects Google Login Services as the cloud application.

quotes: Google Apps: Select Google Login Services as the cloud application.

webex-rule.statement: For Webex Teams and Webex Meetings, the SSL/TLS Inspection rule selects Webex Login Services as the cloud application.

quotes: Webex Teams/Webex Meetings: Select Webex Login Services as the cloud application.

microsoft-no-auth-exemption.statement: For the Microsoft Version 1 profile, the Help form says not to exempt the tenant domains from authentication.

quotes: Do not exempt these domains from authentication.
